name: cs-research-studio
description: A multi-agent team for computer science research: literature survey, innovation positioning, experiment design, and academic writing, with quality gates at every stage.

displayDescription.en: A multi-agent team covering the full CS research pipeline: literature survey, innovation positioning, experiment design, reproducible code, and academic writing, orchestrated by a lead agent with stage-level quality gates.
displayDescription.zh: 面向计算机大类科研全流程：调研文献、定位创新点、设计实验、复现代码、打磨论文，多角色协作一站式交付。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我打算研究「课题名」，请团队帮我完成从文献调研到实验设计的开题准备
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm working on [topic]. Help my team prepare a research proposal from literature survey to experiment design.

quickPrompts.en: I'm working on [topic]. Help my team prepare a research proposal from literature survey to experiment design.
quickPrompts.zh: 我打算研究「课题名」，请团队帮我完成从文献调研到实验设计的开题准备

quickPrompts.en: Compare retrieval-augmented methods from the last three years and help me find a feasible innovation point.
quickPrompts.zh: 对比近三年的检索增强方法，帮我定位一个可落地的创新点

quickPrompts.en: Given these experiment results, write the experiment section of my paper and check the wording.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据这组实验结果，帮我把论文实验章节写出来并检查表述
